summary_en: FY2027 March annual dividend per share raised to 170 yen from previous forecast of 130 yen, comprising interim dividend of 90 yen already paid, year-end ordinary dividend of 50 yen (up 10 yen), and commemorative dividend of 30 yen for 40th anniversary. Previous year paid 125 yen total.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revisions to Earnings Forecasts and Dividend Forecasts (Dividend Increase and Commemorative Dividend)
translation_en_brief:
Innotech announced a revision to its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 2027. The company raised the annual dividend per share to 170 yen from the previously forecast 130 yen. This comprises the interim dividend of 90 yen already paid, an ordinary year-end dividend of 50 yen (increased by 10 yen from the prior forecast of 40 yen), and a commemorative dividend of 30 yen to mark the company's 40th anniversary. The total annual dividend represents a 45 yen increase compared to the previous fiscal year's 125 yen.

The revision reflects stronger-than-expected business performance in the first half of the fiscal year. The Test Solutions division benefited from strong sales of memory testers and post-process inspection boards, while the Systems and Services division captured robust demand from semiconductors, social infrastructure, and defense sectors despite challenging conditions in automotive and vending machine markets. Semiconductor design-related operations also performed solidly.

The company's dividend policy is anchored in linking distributions to earnings performance while maintaining stable shareholder returns. Management expects the favorable trends to continue through the remainder of the fiscal year.
